 Coram:
 Justice Chittaranjan Dash
 Order
Order No. 21.07.2023
01. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and the State.

2. This is an application for bail U/s. 438 Cr.P.C filed by the Petitioners in apprehension of arrest for their alleged involvement in the offences U/s. 420/272/273/34 of IPC, R/w. Section-20 of Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act in connection to G.R case No. 234 of 2023 arising out of Puruna Bazar P.S Case No. 184 of 2023 pending in the file of Ld. S.D.J.M., Bhadrak.

entities.text: Puruna Bazar P.S Case No. 184 of 2023
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. The case record does not disclose the chemical examination report to have been obtained in this case.

4. Having regard to the nature and the gravity of the offences, while this court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail, it is directed in the event the Petitioners surrender before the Court in seisin over the matter within a period of three weeks hence, the learned court concerned shall pass appropriate order in // 2 // accordance with law, having regard to the gravity of the offence and other circumstances on its own merit not being influenced by the direction passed by this Court for disposal of application and shall apply its wisdom by allowing or rejecting the application.
If the court feels so required may obtaining the chemical examination report.

With the above direction,
the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
(Chittaranjan Dash) Judge B.K Sahoo Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA Sk. Kalia @ Sk. Khurban & vs State Of Odisha .... Opp.
